item.createsurvival.steam_ration.tooltip: A hearty meal sealed under pressure that restores hydration when eaten.
Warms Cold Sweat survivors by venting a puff of steam.
Counts as a drink for Thirst Was Taken players.
item.createsurvival.steam_canister.toolt: Pop the valve for emergency regen and a Create-flavored pick-me-up.
The condensation gently cools Cold Sweat temperatures.
Vents clean water vapor for a sizable Thirst refill.
item.createsurvival.surveyor_thermometer: Click to report the local biome temperature.
Displays precise Cold Sweat body readings when available.
item.createsurvival.thermo_vest.tooltip: Kinetic padding soaks environmental extremes like an automatic coat.
Actively balances Cold Sweat body temperature while powered by motion.
block.createsurvival.mechanical_lamp.too: Shines brighter as Create's shafts spin faster beneath it.
block.createsurvival.gyrothermal_regulat: Direction-sensitive climate control that rewards clever gearbox tuning.
tooltip.createsurvival.gyrothermal_regul: Feed the front shaft with clockwise rotation to radiate warmth over a camp.
Flip a clutch or gearbox to reverse the rotor and vent refreshing chills.
